    EICAT impact classification

    Source: R/inv-impact.R
    inv_eicat_score.Rd

    Assigns each alien taxon its Environmental Impact Classification for Alien Taxa (EICAT) category from a table of impact records. Following the IUCN standard, a taxon's category is the most severe impact magnitude recorded for it across all mechanisms: Minimal Concern (MC), Minor (MN), Moderate (MO), Major (MR) or Massive (MV). Taxa with only Data Deficient (DD) records are DD. MO, MR and MV are harmful. A cumulative score (sum over mechanisms of the highest score for each mechanism, with MC = 1 to MV = 5) is also returned to rank taxa within a category.

    Usage

    inv_eicat_score(.data, species, magnitude, mechanism = NULL, confidence = NULL)

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame with one row per impact record.

    species

    <tidy-select> Column with the taxon.

    magnitude

    <tidy-select> Column with the impact magnitude, as codes ("MC", "MN", "MO", "MR", "MV", "DD") or names ("Minimal Concern", "Minor", "Moderate", "Major", "Massive", "Data Deficient"), in any case.

    mechanism

    <tidy-select> Optional column with the impact mechanism (for example competition, predation, hybridisation).

    confidence

    <tidy-select> Optional column with the confidence of each record ("low", "medium", "high").

    Value

    A tibble with one row per taxon, sorted from most to least severe: n_records, eicat_category (an ordered factor with DD as the lowest level), eicat_score (1 to 5, NA for DD), harmful, max_mechanisms (mechanisms with the highest magnitude), confidence (highest confidence among records of the highest magnitude), n_mechanisms and cumulative_score.

    References

    Blackburn, T. M., Essl, F., Evans, T. et al. (2014). A unified classification of alien species based on the magnitude of their environmental impacts. PLoS Biology, 12, e1001850. doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.1001850

    IUCN (2020). IUCN EICAT Categories and Criteria. First edition. IUCN, Gland. doi:10.2305/iucn.ch.2020.05.en

    Examples

    inv_eicat_score(inv_impacts, species = species, magnitude = magnitude,
  mechanism = mechanism, confidence = confidence)
